A '''Rear Warning Sensor''' was a [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] installed on the rear of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to warn the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of spacecraft and sensor sweeps emanating from behind the vessel. [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]] typically employed a [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]] [[K-blakan mini sensor/Legends|k-blakan mini sensor]].<ref name="SWS" />
